Purpose: Explicit project engineering targets, not a claim of commercial-FPS standards or achieved capacity.
Topology: Local Editor dedicated server at a 30 Hz target, independent NullRHI clients with t.MaxFPS 60 fixing the maximum frame/input cadence; NullRHI performs no actual GPU rendering. All clients move and fire into safe open space. Not multiplayer hit-fairness or rendered smoothness acceptance.
Accounting: UNetConnection cumulative bytes/packets include engine protocol and PacketOverhead accounting, not NIC capture or payload-only bytes. ReplicationTickFlush is driver elapsed scope; WorldTickCpu is measured thread CPU. Missing measurements invalidate acceptance; no division of driver costs across connections.
ChangePolicy: Freeze before runs. Changes require a stated gameplay or capacity requirement; never widen budgets to relabel an existing failure. Raw reports remain immutable.
